runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 reaches new AI contracts 180 days after the memo is issued. The rule covers contracts awarded from solicitations released on or after that day, and it also covers renewal or extension options exercised on existing contracts after that day. This memorandum shall apply to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum, as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

The memo's own compliance table also lists a 180-day deadline, stating that each agency must achieve full compliance with the memo's guidance in that window. Achieve full compliance with the guidance of this memorandum. The document does not give a calendar date for that deadline beyond the 180-day count.
